amendment: Before computing benchmark performance, v1 (4096 tokens) and v2 (16384 tokens) were stopped due to repeated reasoning-budget truncations. All records retained. v3 reruns all calls with thinking disabled, temperature zero and JSON mode. This is a direct-answer LLM baseline, not a test of the strongest reasoning model. Data and scoring unchanged.
inference: descriptive pilot only; six generated configurations from one model family; no population significance claims
failure_policy: retain failed rows; never substitute canned answers for unavailable LLM responses
noise_definition: Each historical decision is sampled from strictly suboptimal feasible plans whose relative cost gap is at most the budget. If none exist keep the optimum. Report realized changed fraction separately.
test_policy: Held-out decisions and oracle coefficients never enter learner prompts or validation-based feedback acceptance. No tuning on test scores.
